sections.h2: Cypress Point Home Prices and Market Pace
sections.html:
In the 24 months from November 15, 2024 to November 14, 2026, 116 residential sales closed in Cypress Point (Virginia Beach, VA) according to REIN MLS records. The median sold price was $382,500, close to the citywide median of $405,000, and homes took a median of 26 days to sell, slower than the citywide median of 15 days. These figures come from closed sales, which show what homes actually sold for rather than asking prices.

The middle half of Cypress Point sales closed between $325,000 and $550,750, or about $203 per square foot against $240 citywide. Split by year, the median sold price in the most recent 12 months ($380,000, 57 sales) was about 13% lower than in the earlier 12 months ($435,000, 59 sales). The typical home sold right at its list price (median sale-to-list ratio of 100%).

sections.h2: What Kinds of Homes Sell in Cypress Point
sections.html:
45% of the sales were detached homes and 55% were attached homes (townhomes or condos). The median home was about 2,042 square feet, with the middle half of sales running from roughly 1,729 to 2,501 square feet. 44% of the homes that sold had 3 bedrooms.

Most homes that sold were built between 1987 and 2000, with a median year built of 1989, so this is mostly homes from the 1970s through the 1990s.

Averages hide a lot, so Chris Jenkins compares you to homes that match yours on street, size, age and condition rather than to the whole Cypress Point median.
